existingOwner: Server verified symbolicAccountIdentity / RUNTIME_DB; same-origin writes
semantics: References and content digests only; public Atlas context is never a personal fact
retention: Explicit 7/30/90/365 days; expired records excluded; no membership requirement
compatibility: Additive table; existing customer records untouched
rollback: Disable new flag and consumer; retain rows until owner-approved retention handling
versionHistory: Owner/object/content-digest version rows retained; repeated identical save is idempotent
